records.title: Lightning Network paper formalizes Bitcoin payment-channel network
records.summary: Joseph Poon and Thaddeus Dryja's Lightning Network paper proposed scalable off-chain instant payments routed through networks of Bitcoin payment channels.
records.significance: Lightning became Bitcoin's dominant second-layer payments architecture and a central answer to the scaling debate.

records.title: Ethereum Homestead upgrade activates
records.summary: Ethereum's Homestead hard fork moved the network beyond the experimental Frontier phase.
records.significance: Homestead represented increasing confidence in Ethereum's live smart-contract platform immediately before The DAO era.

records.title: The DAO raises more than 11.5 million ETH
records.summary: The DAO conducted a token sale that raised more than 11.5 million ETH, then worth roughly $150 million.
records.significance: It became an unprecedented blockchain crowdfunding and governance experiment and set the stage for Ethereum's defining governance crisis.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — The DAO hack and Ethereum Classic

records.title: The DAO is exploited through reentrancy
records.summary: An attacker exploited recursive-call behavior in The DAO and began draining Ether into a child DAO.
records.significance: The exploit became the defining smart-contract security failure of early Ethereum.

sources.title: Ethereum Foundation — Critical Update re DAO Vulnerability

records.title: Second Bitcoin halving
records.summary: Bitcoin's block subsidy fell from 25 BTC to 12.5 BTC.
records.significance: The second halving reinforced Bitcoin's fixed issuance schedule and cemented halvings as recurring mining and market milestones.

records.title: Ethereum forks after The DAO; Ethereum Classic continues unforked chain
records.summary: At block 1,920,000, Ethereum hard-forked to move DAO-related Ether to a refund contract; miners opposing the intervention continued the original chain as Ethereum Classic.
records.significance: The split permanently demonstrated that blockchain governance depends on social consensus as well as code.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — The DAO hack and Ethereum Classic

records.title: Bitfinex loses 119,755 BTC in security breach
records.summary: Bitfinex suffered a breach in which 119,755 BTC were stolen.
records.significance: It was one of crypto's largest exchange thefts and later became notable for its BFX recovery token and massive law-enforcement recovery.

records.title: Rare Pepes create a Bitcoin-native collectible culture
records.summary: The first Rare Pepe Counterparty cards appeared in early September and the Rare Pepe Directory began organizing the collection days later.
records.significance: Rare Pepes created a native blockchain art/collectible culture on Bitcoin before the Ethereum NFT boom.

sources.title: Book of Kek — Rare Pepe Series 1

records.title: Zcash launches with shielded zk-SNARK transactions
records.summary: Zcash launched its Sprout mainnet using zk-SNARKs for shielded transactions.
records.significance: Zcash brought production zero-knowledge privacy to a permissionless cryptocurrency and helped mainstream advanced cryptographic proofs.

sources.title: Electric Coin Company — Zcash Launch and Roadmap

records.title: MetaMask is created as an Ethereum browser wallet
records.summary: Aaron Davis and Dan Finlay created MetaMask in 2016 as a self-custodial Ethereum browser wallet/extension.
records.significance: MetaMask became the dominant consumer gateway to Ethereum dapps, DeFi and NFTs.

records.title: BitMEX launches perpetual XBTUSD leveraged swap
records.summary: BitMEX launched what it described as the world's first perpetual Bitcoin/USD leveraged swap, with no expiry and leverage up to 100x.
records.significance: The perpetual swap became crypto's defining derivatives instrument and was copied across nearly every major trading venue.

sources.title: BitMEX — Launch of Perpetual XBTUSD Leveraged Swap
